description: Create a FreeAgent project against a client contact. A project is what expenses, bills and time are tagged to, and what rebilling bills on to. Only contact and name are needed — currency defaults to GBP, budget to zero and status to Active.

billingPeriod.description: Whether the billing rate is per hour or per day

budget.description: Budget figure, in the units given by budgetUnits (default 0 — no budget)

budgetUnits.description: What the budget counts — Hours, Days or Monetary (ex-VAT). Default Hours.

contact.description: FreeAgent contact URL for the client. Use freeagent_list_contacts to find it.

contractPoReference.description: Client contract or purchase order reference

hoursPerDay.description: Hours in a working day, for day-rate billing

includeUnbilledTimeInProfitability.description: Count unbilled time towards the project's profitability figures

isIr35.description: Whether the engagement is inside IR35

name.description: Project name (e.g. 'Example Client Ltd — Q3 build')

normalBillingRate.description: Standard billing rate for time on this project

usesProjectInvoiceSequence.description: Number this project's invoices in their own sequence rather than the company-wide one

name: freeagent_create_project
